title: GAD-7 Anxiety
description: Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item (GAD-7) scale. Used for screening and measuring the severity of generalized anxiety disorder.

introductions.scoring_rule: Assign scores of 0, 1, 2, and 3 to the responses: 'not at all', 'several days', 'more than half the days', and 'nearly every day', respectively. Total score ranges from 0 to 21.

questions: 1. Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
2. Not being able to stop or control worrying
3. Worrying too much about different things
5. Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
7. Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

additional_questions.question: If you checked any problems, how difficult have they made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
